raw:
The user wants app UI strings in Traditional Chinese (Taiwan usage). Three strings:

- s1: feedback form submit button — sends content to the team
- s2: settings page button to write/save changes
- s3: status text after changes are written/saved

Guidelines: Taiwan terms. 提交→送出, 保存→儲存. So s1 should be like「送出意見」or「送出」。The button sends content to the team — maybe「送出意見」.

s2: settings save button —「儲存變更」or「儲存設定」. Since it writes changes (寫入變更), Taiwan usage typically「儲存變更」.

s3: status text after changes written —「變更已儲存」or「您的變更已儲存」. Status text: 「變更已儲存」。

Output only a JSON object.{"s1": "送出意見", "s2": "儲存變更", "s3": "變更已儲存"}
